::: {.panel-tabset}
## Plot

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| fig-cap: "Joy Division plot of daily temperature anomalies"
// One area per year; the height of each area is the share of days at a given anomaly,
// and every year is shifted up by one row so that the most recent year ends up at the bottom.
chart = Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: "currentColor", strokeOpacity: 0.35, strokeDasharray: "3,4"}),
    Plot.areaY(joyData,
      { x: "anomaly"
      , y1: fromBottom ? "reference" : 0
      , y2: "height"
      , z: "year"
      , fillOpacity: opacity
      , stroke: "white"
      , fill: colorMode === "Single color" ? color : "yearMean" }),
    showTrend
      ? Plot.line(yearStats, {x: "mean", y: "reference", stroke: "#d62728", strokeWidth: 1.6})
      : null,
    Plot.axisY(labelledYears.map(d => d.reference), {
      label: "Year",
      text: labelledYears.map(d => String(d.year)),
      grid: true
    }),
    Plot.axisX({
      label: "Daily temperature anomaly (°C)",
      ticks: xTicks,
      tickFormat: d => (d > 0 ? "+" : "") + d
    })
  ],
  x: {label: "Daily temperature anomaly (°C)", domain: [-limit, limit]},
  y: {label: "Year"},
  color: colorScale,
  width: 800,
  height: Math.round((years.length - 1 + ridgeHeight) * 12) + 70, // 12 px per year
  title: `${placeName}: daily temperature anomalies, ${minYear}–${maxYear}`,
  subtitle: `Anomaly relative to the ${baseline} daily normal · ${sourceNote}`
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Colour key, only needed when lines are coloured by the yearly mean
legend = colorMode === "Single color"
  ? html``
  : Plot.legend({color: colorScale, width: 320, marginLeft: 10})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| panel: sidebar
viewof opacity = Inputs.range([0, 1], {step: 0.1, value: 0.9, label: "Opacity"})
viewof ridgeHeight = Inputs.range([1, 8], {step: 0.5, value: 4, label: "Ridge height"})
viewof smoothFactor = Inputs.range([0, 4], {step: 1, value: 2, label: "Smooth factor"})
viewof fromBottom = Inputs.toggle({label: "wave only", value: false})
viewof showTrend = Inputs.toggle({label: "yearly mean", value: true})
viewof colorMode = Inputs.select(["Single color", "RdYlBu by yearly mean"], {label: "Colour"})
viewof color = Inputs.color({label: "Single color", value: "#004055"})
viewof maxLightness = Inputs.range([40, 100], {step: 1, value: 65, label: "Max lightness"})
viewof baseline = Inputs.select(["1991-2020", "1961-1990"], {label: "Reference period"})
viewof normalWindow = Inputs.range([0, 15], {step: 1, value: 3, label: "Normal window (± days)"})

DOM.download(() => serialize(chart.querySelector("svg")), undefined, "Download the SVG")
```
